name: HatchGrab
subtitle: Food truck: orders and kitchen
promotionalText: Take pre-orders, protect the kitchen from too many orders and keep serving when you lose signal. The ordering app for food truck staff.
description:
HatchGrab is the ordering and kitchen app for food trucks: the tool your team runs service with.

Customers order ahead and choose a collection time. Your staff see every order on a single screen, confirm what the kitchen can prepare and then mark each order as ready and collected.

DON’T PROMISE A TIME YOU CAN’T KEEP
Set how much your kitchen can cook at once and how much time it needs. When a collection time is full, customers can’t choose it, so the queue fits the kitchen’s pace.

TAKE ORDERS AT THE FOOD TRUCK
Add in-person orders to the same screen as pre-orders, so the kitchen works from a single queue.

A SINGLE SCREEN FOR THE KITCHEN
The kitchen screen shows what to prepare now, what comes next and what is already ready, and alerts you when an order needs starting.

PRINT ORDER TICKETS
Connect a kitchen ticket printer over Bluetooth or the local network, and order tickets print automatically.

KEEP SERVING WHEN YOU LOSE SIGNAL
Switch on offline protection and, if the connection drops, pre-orders pause so nobody places an order you won’t see. Orders you take on the device are saved and sync when you have a connection again.

DESIGNED FOR THE FOOD TRUCK
Use it on iPhone or iPad. Keep the screen on during service, get a notification when an order needs confirming and lock the app with Face ID or Touch ID.

PLAN THE WEEK
Set up your events and places just once and take orders for each one.

HatchGrab is for people who run food trucks and their staff. You need a HatchGrab account to sign in.
whatsNew:
